scope: One direction and mathematical-filter review; not a review of all new implementations or final graphs.
accepted_scoped_items: Finite profile failures do not close entire groups or general graph families.
Conditional on correct DP enumeration, Moore bounds for arbitrary factors suffice to stop plain Cartesian and strong products in the 27 saved cases.

corrections: The reviewer calls triangle-free movement 'strict bipartite alternation'. Triangle-free does not imply bipartite. Our proof only uses the absence of closed controller walks of lengths one and three, together with the exact two-step return relation.
The product review occasionally says 'direct product'. The checked formulas and our exclusion concern Cartesian and strong products; no tensor/direct-product exclusion is asserted.
later_evidence: The selected single-matching/internal-shift template has a concrete controller pair 0->90 with the unique length-three route 0-3-89-90. This independently checked obstruction closes that fixed source+matching template, including arbitrary invertible linear maps.
